description.value: The Birds & The Beets is a casual all-day breakfast and lunch café occupying a corner location in Vancouver's Gastown area, accessible from both Powell Street and Alexander Street. The menu leans toward globally-inspired comfort food — think Miso Barley Bowls, Tofu Banh Mi, and blueberry sourdough waffles — alongside a full espresso bar and fresh-pressed juices. Its compact, neighbourhood-café character and proximity to the downtown waterfront cycling routes make it a natural mid-ride refuelling stop.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 47m; stands (12 spaces) at 51m; stands (4 spaces) at 66m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and confirms the business is active, operating as an all-day breakfast and lunch café. The website title shows '55 Powell St // 54 Alexander St, Vancouver,' suggesting a corner location with two street frontages, while OSM records only '54 Alexander Street' — a minor discrepancy flagged below. No explicit evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or most optional amenities appears anywhere in the website content; however, the menu clearly includes multiple vegetarian and plant-based options (Tofu Banh Mi, Miso Barley Bowl, Hummus & Pickled Veggie Toast, Cashew & Jam Toast), supporting a true value for that amenity.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records only '54 Alexander Street' but the website consistently shows '55 Powell St // 54 Alexander St, Vancouver,' suggesting a corner building with dual street addresses. The Powell St address is absent from OSM.
